profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm a technology enthusiast with a particular interest in mobile and web. I have 10+ years of experience in software development professionally. My goal is to obtain a position as a team lead or full stack web application developer on platforms that solve interesting problems. Find my resume here: https://bit.ly/314Q3rT

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at The Sports Market LLC, I design, build, and maintain the company’s e-commerce platform for sports merchandise. I develop both front-end and back-end features, ensure fast and secure user experiences, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support product launches and business goals. I also contribute to system architecture, improve performance and reliability, and help developers to maintain high engineering standards.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Python (Programming Language) · DAML · Docker

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Accomplishments

• Worked on enhancements to improve performance, accessibility and best practices.
• Improved workflow by reducing build steps, changing/upgrading tooling and linting code.
• Improved mobile compatibility by fixing cross platform functionality and responsive layout issues.
• Made RequireJS front end ES6 compatible/compilable using UglifyJS.
• Refactored/changed static libraries to dynamic ones via bower + yarn.
• Refactored css to scss using SASS.

(languages used: HTML5/JavaScript/CSS and Python, frameworks used: Backbone, Marionette and SocketIO, frontend tooling: Bower, Yarn, RequireJS, webpack, backend: Celery, Gunicorn, nginx Tornado and Django).

Duties

• Fix vulnerabilities as a result of system audits
• Designing and developing new/core features of the product.
• Performing peer code reviews.
• Producing documentation with the team for the features being developed.
• Maintaining the system with bug fixes.
positions.insights: Skills: Event Driven · Software Lifecycle · Communication · Infrastructure Solutions · Troubleshooting · Front-end Engineering · Debugging · Team Leadership · Scrum · Problem Solving · Computer Science

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Accomplishments

• Helped design and develop an Angular2 application to replace original core application.
• Leveraged Redux to manage state in the application coupled with Angular2 to deliver a modern day web application.

Key Responsibilities

• Designing and developing core features of the product.
• Performing code reviews.
• Creating unit tests for existing and new code bases.
• Producing documentation with the team for the features being developed.
• Maintaining the system with bug fixes.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Accomplishments

• Developed and maintained a native iOS, Android and Blackberry wrapper.
• Lead a team to make the core web app responsive.
• Mitigated transition of revision control from SVN to git.
• Helped coach colleagues on the principles of git.
• Mitigated transition of issue tracking from Trac to Jira.
• Researched and implemented a framework agnostic JavaScript module pattern.
• Researched and implemented mobile web app solutions, developed and maintained a cross-platform mobile web app using the Rhomobile framework.

Key responsibilities

• Actively participate in component design and implementation for our main web app using MooTools and Velocity.
• Openly communicate with teams to derive elegant and scalable solutions.
• Generate XHTML using MVC and bootstrap JS behaviours as necessary
• Design and develop interactive components driven by the API to enhance usability.
• Polish the final results by conforming to existing markup and CSS.
• Upgrade third party components and test them.
• Write tests using QUnit.
• Review peer work.

Necessary knowledge, skills and abilities

• Scale walls like Spider-Man.
• JavaScript ninja training.
• Experience and understanding of online social networks.
• Excellent knowledge in Ruby, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Mootools, jQuery mobile, using MVC frameworks and cross browser compatibility.
• Native mobile development and all things mobile web related.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Lifecycle · Communication · Infrastructure Solutions · Troubleshooting · Front-end Engineering · Debugging · Team Leadership · Scrum · Problem Solving · Computer Science

positions.title: Research & Development Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed an energy monitoring solution for industrial energy targeting.
• Researching new technologies for developing applications in .NET and Silverlight frameworks
• Implementing jQuery plug-ins to enhance web applications
• Designing and implementing user interfaces (Silverlight, .NET, HTML5 + CSS3)
• Helped design and implement N-Tier architecture from a SQL Server back-end to
a BLL exposed via WCF, and a Silverlight front-end.
• Helped implement and maintain previously existing ASP.NET components of
the application suite.
• Used T-SQL stored procedures (SQL Server 2008 R2) to obtain presentable data to an end user.
• Leveraged MEF, Unity Application Block, Caliburn-Micro, and the Model-View-
• ViewModel development pattern to increase productivity (client-side).
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Troubleshooting · Front-end Engineering · Debugging · Problem Solving · Computer Science
